postal_system.assignment_rule: Lietuvos paštas postcode and address search is the postal assignment authority. It resolves city or settlement, street, house number, postcode, post office, address, and municipality membership; a lookup result is not an official polygon.
postal_system.endpoint_rule: Post offices, PO boxes, parcel terminals, large receivers, organizations, and other delivery endpoints remain non-areal unless an independent source explicitly supplies valid geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: The Registrų centras Address Register supplies official civic-address points and hierarchy for parcels, buildings, and premises under its published open-data contract. It does not replace Lietuvos paštas as postal assignment authority.
postal_system.postal_surface_rule: A surface may be derived only from a pinned, rights-cleared, complete postal membership and address-point snapshot. It remains derived and noncanonical; gaps and conflicts are preserved rather than filled by administrative boundaries or proximity.
postal_system.building_rule: Registrų centras NTR building boundaries supply building geometry. A building is exact only through a stable explicit registry identifier relation or reviewed crosswalk; containment and nearest-footprint results remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Address Register county, municipality, eldership, settlement, and street geometry adds context but cannot create, clip, or replace a Lietuvos paštas postcode assignment.
postal_system.territory_rule: All published features remain within Lithuania's LT partition; Latvia, Belarus, Poland, and Russia/Kaliningrad geometry must never be absorbed by border interpolation.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal assignment and registry object validity when supplied by the source.
temporal_model.known_time: Source publication, ingest, correction, and release timestamps retained separately.
temporal_model.history_rule: Current and historical registry objects remain versioned; a later postcode mapping never rewrites an earlier release.

quality_gates.pass: Each official assignment points to a pinned Lietuvos paštas lookup receipt or rights-cleared source edition.
Each derived surface records member addresses, method, coverage, exclusions, source digest, and noncanonical status.
Address identity and point geometry retain registry identifier, hierarchy, lifecycle, CRS, and source release.
An exact building claim has a stable explicit source relation or reviewed crosswalk; nearest and containment are candidates only.
No recipient, resident, owner, tenant, customer, phone, private-unit occupant, credential, or protected register subject is published.
Synthetic fixtures test behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, coverage, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
